candidate: Derive the exact U/G two-sign ensemble identity for arbitrary reused variables, isolate the realized-sign projection, and test whether the binary posterior KL reserve pays the active-policy companion.
prior_status: The active-policy companion grouped LC as C+P^q-R_qP^q_child, but no signed actual/companion or posterior payment was known; fixed-sign projection and unsigned coefficient-four closure were refuted.
mathematical_delta: For every Boolean pair, proved average U=M-K and average G=LM-LK with an exact binary posterior KL K. For f_+=gh,f_-=g, proved 2Z_D=D(h)+(1-b)C+2aJ+P^q-R_qP^q_child. Removed all overlap/activation hypotheses from the ensemble center. Certified a three-bit K=0, P^q=1 witness refuting any finite root-posterior multiplier.

gu_implication.sufficient_condition: For each nonconstant f_+, choose a Boolean companion f_- with nonpositive pair center and nonpositive projection Z=(D_+-D_-)/2.
gu_implication.status: CONDITIONAL; the signed projection remains open

case_extension.previous_class: active-policy collision grouping with an unpaid signed companion
case_extension.new_class: exact two-sign U/G ensemble center for every Boolean pair on arbitrarily reused physical variables
removed_hypotheses: positive lower bound on activation weight
case_extension.remaining_hypothesis: a joint signed projection bound retaining the companion factor defect, posterior drift and root/child/terminal companion ownership
case_extension.parameter_dependence: the proved identities have no dimension, depth, overlap, bias, activation, or tensor-count constant

verification.method: exact rational Walsh masses and influences plus deterministic floating logarithms

normalization_and_terminal_terms: The sign-blind q is a normalized spectral law because both f_+,f_- are Boolean.
m is exactly the upper mass of q; zero masses contribute zero.
K is retained as a signed restriction drift bK-LK, not replaced by an unsigned credit.
The product projection retains D(h), P^q and R_qP^q_child separately.
The zero-K witness cancels only after the companion factor defect is retained.
The FEI reduction is invoked only conditionally after universal GU with b<1.
obstruction_controls: No fixed-sign projection from the ensemble is assumed.
No unsigned coefficient-four or larger coefficient is assumed.
K>=0 is not used to assign a sign to LK.
The K=0, P^q=1 witness refutes posterior-only payment but is not a GU or FEI counterexample.
Positive three-bit, negative two-bit, tensor and rare-activation controls are tested.
remaining_obstacle: Prove one joint signed projection inequality coupling D(h), bK-LK, (1-b)C+2aJ, and root/child/terminal companions with single-use ownership.
next_action: Construct a branchwise posterior martingale carrying the companion factor label h, and test exact drift first on the zero-K isometric-defect witness and then on the positive collision tensor.
